idea-plugin.name: OMP IDE Bridge (Community)
idea-plugin.description:
Unofficial community bridge between JetBrains IDEs and Oh My Pi sessions.

  • Shares the active file, current selection, open editors, and IDE diagnostics.
  • Lets connected OMP agents open files, save documents, and inspect diagnostics.
  • Adds an editor action that mentions the selected code in the next OMP turn.
  • Reviews OMP changes in native Diff Window with Accept and safe Refuse actions.

Communication uses an authenticated WebSocket bound to 127.0.0.1. The OMP-side extension is required. VS Code-compatible version
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Native post-edit diff review with Accept and Refuse.

  • Accept keeps changes; Refuse restores the reviewed file state without overwriting later edits.
  • Supports new and deleted files, including empty files.
  • Compatibility verified against IntelliJ IDEA Community 2023.1.7 and 2024.3.1.

action.description: Send the current editor selection to connected OMP sessions
